data_label: G0.5 DEVELOPMENT — nominal value-added production-function simulation; not real TFP or final findings
capital: Log positive previous-calendar-year capital_stock_nominal. Reported totals are assumed to be year-end stocks across all supplied years; documentary verification flags are preserved, not used to exclude assumed values.
capital_timing: Beginning stock at t equals reported year-end stock at t-1 on the same fictional firm and actual calendar. No2009 or2016 stock invented.
op_proxy: Log positive capital_additions_nominal across supplied years, treated as an assumed investment candidate separately from the stock convention. Original documentary flags remain; absent/zero/negative values are not imputed.
lp_acf_wrdg_proxy: log positive val_rtlvcu, reported raw/supporting materials candidate
deflation: None. Real-input admission remains false. Prices and measurement effects remain in nominal residuals.
units_assumption: Each candidate variable uses a consistent positive unit scale across retained observations within a technology cell. This is a maintained development convention, not verified supplier-scale evidence; year/firm-varying unit errors are not corrected.
technology: Separate observed two-digit manufacturing sectors; pooled constant production slopes and proxy/control laws across retained years. No year fixed effects are added. Sector codes remain provisional across classification vintages; nominal prices and changing composition can affect estimates and annual residual differences.
synthetic_selection: One risk interval for every source fictional firm at each adjacent supplied calendar-year pair. Missing assignment at next year gives simulated disappearance1; continuer0. No interval spans missing2016 or follows terminal2022. These intervals are not source production records or verified firm closures.
sampling: Own pre-lag positive domains and four-method common pre-lag domain; each estimator requires exact consecutive-calendar production domains. All supported dynamic years enter sector-pooled estimation.
centering: Freeze medians of logged y,l,k,proxy inside each declared method×sample×technology positive domain before numerical fit; return native-log structural residuals using unchanged slope estimates. Complete polynomial translation preserves the intended span; condition/optimizer diagnostics remain necessary.
inference_scope: Exploratory full-process synthetic-firm cluster resampling, conditional on frozen fictional linkage and candidate measurement convention. Not the required999-draw real-VA primary acceptance. No generator uncertainty or actual population inference claimed.
outputs: Method/technology/sample coefficients, failed/skipped cells, primary predictions attached on all valid original domain rows with separate dynamic-estimation flags; pooled dynamic residual distributions plus annual prediction diagnostics; all exact consecutive-year paired changes.
actual_finalisation: Not allowed for this compatibility contract; requires accepted real inputs/linkage and an explicitly reviewed final specification
capital_assumption: Owner-authorized2026-09-14: treat reported capital_stock_nominal as year-end stock for all available years. This is a maintained calculation assumption, not new source authentication.
normalization: Subtract each sector-method-sample primary fit's mean raw residual across its pooled dynamic estimation records, keeping this same constant across every prediction year. Index=exp(centered log residual); reference geometric mean1 across pooled dynamic records.

owner_authorization.instruction: Assume reported capital is the stock, calculate all available years, revise every result and appendix, state caveat.
